inclusion_rule: Speech or language decoders from EEG, MEG or intracranial recordings that initialize a vision backbone pretrained on natural images (ImageNet CNN or ViT) and fine-tune it, or train a head on it, using time-frequency or other image-like neural inputs. Boundary: decoding of images viewed during EEG (ImageNet as stimulus set) is excluded; non-speech imagery (e.g. visual arrows) and reviews remain as pattern matches (upper bound); versions of one study count once.

sota_candidates.raw: average decoding accuracy up to 96% for spoken phrases (CNN)

These deep ConvNets are pre-trained with more than a million images of 1, 000 categories from the ImageNet database
whereas, with SST-CNN the accuracies were 90.38 ± 2.28%, 93.24 ± 2.87%, and 96.65 ± 2.88%
During the training on imagined speech data, the ResNet model layers are frozen and only the appended FC layers are trained

usual_approach_decoding-imagined-and-spo.note: Target-time population (one setting for M03, M06 and M12): decoders that classify imagined, covert, inner or internal speech (or an imagination or preparation stage) from human electrophysiological recordings (scalp EEG, MEG, ECoG, depth or intracortical), first public before 2019-01; target time 2019-07, the date of the same group's EMBC 2019 conference paper on CNN transfer learning for MEG speech decoding (doi:10.1109/EMBC.2019.8857874; unread, not in the wiki); journal received 2019-08, published 2020-04; [concurrent] 2019-01 to 2020-01. Found by a full-text pattern over the whole wiki (imagined/covert/inner speech or imagination/covert/imagery stage terms and an electrophysiology term, each at least 3 times; the stage terms were added after the first scan missed Dash et al. 2018) and triaged by hand; excluded: fMRI and fNIRS, reviews, theses duplicating published studies, listening-only or overt-only decoding, analyses without a decoder, synthetic data (arxiv-1705.07771), attempted or inner speech from implanted unit recordings (Brumberg 2011; Sarmah and Kennedy 2013, pmc-4437274), motor-imagery speech synthesis (Kennedy 2018), EEG biometrics; versions once. 16 prior unique studies: Suppes 1997 (EEG and MEG), Deng 2010, Torres-Garcia 2012, Leuthardt 2011, Pei 2011, Martin 2014, Ikeda 2014, Martin 2016, Yoshimura 2016, Min 2016, s41133 2016, ICA conceptual words 2017, Nguyen 2017, Jahangiri 2018, Rezazadeh Sereshkeh 2018 thesis, Dash et al. 2018 (MEG, same group and paradigm). 8 [concurrent]: Saha 2019 (three papers), covert-speech 2019, imagined-speech EEG thesis 2019, JAMT 2019, Singh 2019, Dash 2019 Interspeech. ImageNet-pretrained CNN in 0 of 16 prior and 0 of 8 [concurrent] (pattern match, full text). Whole-wiki full-text recall check (any electrophysiological speech decoding paper first public up to 2019, any task, overt included): ImageNet or named vision backbone within 80 characters of pretraining or transfer, or a scalogram, spectrogram or time-frequency image within 150 characters of CNN: 2 hits, both off-design (arxiv-1912.07730 states it avoided pretrained ResNet or VGG; pmc-6901702 is a review).
